description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the 'Target' interface, representing a message target in a connectivity model. It includes fields for address, topics, QoS level, authorization context, acknowledgement labels, header and payload mappings, along with methods for JSON serialization, object creation from JSON, and building instances with a builder pattern.

classes.name: ImmutableTarget
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the Target interface, encapsulating target details such as address, topics, QoS, authorization, acknowledgment, header, and payload mappings, with JSON serialization and deserialization capabilities.

classes.name: ImmutableTarget.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for creating ImmutableTarget instances with fluent API, ensuring thread safety and proper initialization.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a new Target object from a JSON representation, parsing fields like topics, authorization context, acknowledgment labels, header and payload mappings.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes this target instance into a JsonObject according to the specified schema version and predicate.
